environment.description: ECS Fargate task running Amazon Linux 2 container with default security context. The order-service container runs as uid 1000 with read-write access to /var/log/order-service/. Log files are rotated by logrotate and shipped to CloudWatch via the awslogs driver. No input validation middleware is applied to SQS message bodies. The container filesystem is writable and no MAC policy is enforced (Fargate default).
